title: Find Closest Person
summary: Given the positions x, y, and z of three people on a number line, where Person 1 and Person 2 move towards Person 3 at the same speed, determine which person reaches Person 3 first by returning 1 if Person 1 arrives first, 2 if Person 2 arrives first, and 0 if both arrive simultaneously.
statement: Given the positions x, y, and z of three people on a number line, where Person 1 and Person 2 move towards Person 3 at the same speed, determine which person reaches Person 3 first by returning 1 if Person 1 arrives first, 2 if Person 2 arrives first, and 0 if both arrive simultaneously.
constraints: Two people at x and y move toward the person at z at equal speed.
Return 1 if x is closer, 2 if y is closer, and 0 for equal distances.
hints: Compute each absolute distance to z.
The smaller distance arrives first because speeds match.
Return the matching label, or zero when equal.
No movement simulation is needed because time is proportional to distance.
editorial: No movement simulation is needed because time is proportional to distance.
